purpose: Make a source-pass immediately executable through the frozen pre-2024 ML screen, broad prewritten risk search and official 2024H1 sequential research interval without adding a later purity gate.

market_data.provider: Bybit official public MetaTrader4 kline archive
market_data.availability: one-minute bar is usable only after its close; entry uses the next exact contiguous minute open strictly after event availability
market_data.gaps: never imputed; reset rolling state and invalidate every feature or label crossing the gap

funding.primary: Bybit V5 public funding history at recorded fundingRateTimestamp
funding.fallback: if an exact historical settlement is unavailable, charge an adverse unsigned 2 bp per crossed UTC 00/08/16 boundary and never credit funding
funding.cashflow: long pays positive rate and receives negative rate; short has the opposite cashflow

structural_liquidity.bar: exact contiguous completed UTC 60-minute OHLC from 1-minute Bybit bars
structural_liquidity.confirmation: a pivot becomes available only after two complete hourly bars on its right
structural_liquidity.active_pool: confirmed pivot remains active until a completed one-minute bar consumes it
structural_liquidity.entry_requires: nearest active upper and lower pools each at least 12 bp from entry

event_and_rows.same_direction_60m: sum prior available event notional with identical mint/burn direction during the preceding 60 minutes, excluding the current event
event_and_rows.net_issuance_24h: signed prior available mint minus burn notional during the preceding 24 hours, excluding the current event
event_and_rows.gas_utilization: event-block gasUsed divided by gasLimit, retrieved from the same keyless Ethereum source before the decision row is finalized

model.calibration: one IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds=clip) when the frozen calibration partition has at least 50 resolved labels and both classes; otherwise raw HGBT probability

labels_and_execution.label: which frozen pool is touched first after entry
fit_excludes: source or market gap before resolution
labels_and_execution.target_fill: frozen target price with no favorable gap improvement
labels_and_execution.stop_fill: worse of structural stop and adverse minute open
labels_and_execution.source_boundary: full structural stop plus all costs

account.participation_cap: 0.1% of prior complete one-minute approximate quote turnover
account.liquidation_safety: effective leverage is additionally capped at 0.8/(stop_distance_fraction+0.005)
account.winner_removal: remove the largest positive 10% of accepted event keys before slot competition and replay from initial NAV
account.calendar_growth: all UTC calendar days in each fixed interval

risk_search.selection: highest 24-bp geometric daily growth on 2023H2 among no-liquidation paths with positive winner-removed return; no 1% cap

official_2024H1.evaluation: same model family, features, action equation, execution and frozen risk/cap; events and Bybit data from 2024H1 are never used to select the 2024H1 version
official_2024H1.decision: report the complete realistic path. If negative, winner-removal negative, central trade negative with no structural improvement path, or otherwise structurally far from 1% daily growth, retire rather than add another pre-gate. A promising result may inform a version frozen with data through 2024-06-30 for 2024H2.
